prompt: Provide a brief description of object-oriented polymorphism. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT 1: Do not use verbs. NEGATIVE CONSTRAINT 2: Format as a semicolon-delimited single line.
evaluation_criteria:
No Verbs: 0-5 (Evaluates noun/adjective phrase structure)

response_text: A mechanism allowing multiple classes with shared interfaces to exhibit different behaviors; inheritance or interfaces define common structure; runtime determination of method implementation via dynamic binding; enables flexible, extensible interactions between objects; avoids hardcoding specific implementations.
